cues.en: a Handy Guide to Workplace Etiquette.
cues.zh: 一本职场礼仪便捷指南。

cues.en: Back in the old days, a workplace was a man's domain.
cues.zh: 从前，职场是男人的地盘。

cues.en: Today, life is not as simple.
cues.zh: 如今，事情可没那么简单了。

cues.en: Businesses are filled with working women,
cues.zh: 公司里到处都是职业女性，
还都带着各自的胸和阴道。

cues.en: As a man, you want to have sex with all of them. But approaching a woman at work should be done with extreme caution to avoid a sexual harassment lawsuit.
cues.zh: 作为男人，你想跟她们每一个上床。但在职场接近女性必须极其谨慎，免得惹上性骚扰官司。

cues.en: Here's the wrong way to approach a female coworker.
cues.zh: 这是接近女同事的错误方式。

cues.en: Maybe we should have lunch sometime.
cues.zh: 有空我们一起吃个午饭吧。

cues.en: Uh-oh. That didn't go over well.
Hey, Lisa. You look pretty hot today. Maybe we should go to lunch sometime. Oh, well, great. How about tomorrow? Okay. Great. See you then.
cues.zh: 嘿，丽莎。你今天看起来真性感。有空我们一起吃个午饭吧。哦，好啊，太好了。明天怎么样？好。太好了，到时候见。

cues.en: Frank was awkward and a little too pushy.
cues.zh: 弗兰克有点笨拙，也太咄咄逼人了。

cues.en: Let's see if Frank can do better with another coworker.
cues.zh: 来看看 Frank 换一个女同事会不会表现得更好。

cues.en: The eye contact makes her uncomfortable,
cues.zh: 眼神接触让她感到不适，
于是她联系了管理部门。

cues.en: Here's what he should have done.
Hey, Greg. Wanna have lunch sometime?
It can be done. You can't have sex with women at work without losing your job by following a few simple rules.
cues.zh: 完全行得通。只要遵守几个简单的规则，你就能在职场上搭讪女同事而不丢工作。
